column3: Close to the Hebrew; אֵשֶׁת־ חַיִל (“a woman of strength”) is rendered “An excellent wife.”
Close to the Hebrew; “is good… and has a servant” is rendered “Better is the one who is slighted but has a servant.”
Close to the Hebrew; “knows the life of his animal” is rendered “regards the life of his animal.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a net of evil things” is rendered “the catch of evil men.”
Close to the Hebrew; “in the transgression of lips is an evil snare” is rendered “The wicked is ensnared by the transgression of his lips.”
Close to the Hebrew; “one who speaks rashly” is rendered “speaks.”
Close to the Hebrew; “until I blink” is rendered “but for a moment.”
Close to the Hebrew; “any trouble” is rendered “No grave trouble.”
Close to the Hebrew; ורְמִיָּה (“slackness”) is rendered “the lazy man.”
The first line is difficult; NKJV renders “The righteous should choose his friends carefully.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the precious wealth of a man is diligent” is rendered “diligence is man’s precious possession.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the way of its path—no death” is rendered “in its pathway there is no death.”
